title: Making a file on a disk
question: The same create and write, on ext4: what does a disk file system keep track of?

stops.note: ext4 makes the file, all in one journal transaction (so a crash leaves all of it, or none).
A free inode for it: found in a block group's inode bitmap, and marked used.
The name "new.txt": into free space in a block of the directory, next to the other names.
Into the page cache, as in memory; but no disk block is chosen yet (delayed allocation): one is only reserved.
